name: Hasiel
title: Levitical clan leader
summary: Hasiel (also spelled Asiel or Hasjiel) was a descendant of Levi and is mentioned in the Levitical genealogies in 1 Chronicles. He was part of the Levitical service system organized during King David's time. His role relates to the Levitical service at the tabernacle and later the temple.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Levi's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Hasiel is mentioned among the Levitical clan leaders who were recorded in 1 Chronicles as part of the organization of the Levitical service.

keyEvents.title: The assignment of duties for the Levites under David
keyEvents.description: As part of the lineage of Levi, Hasiel and his relatives were assigned tasks related to the service at the sanctuary during David's reorganization of temple worship.

keyEvents.title: Organization of the Gershonite line
keyEvents.description: Hasiel belonged to the line of Gershon among the Levites and was recorded as one of the heads of the sons of Laadan within the Gershonite clan.

keyEvents.title: The Role of the Levites in Worship
keyEvents.description: Hazi'el and the other Levitical clan leaders were central to establishing the organized worship that David prepared for the coming temple in Jerusalem.
